items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: He said that's between Tainsey and Abby and that Georgie they did that.

ctx.x: man had such cranks. He was so sick of the Elmire pleasure ground. He doubled up. And Georgie was laughing. And laughing. And Abby put the corned down. He was rolling on the bandstand. I said what is all this about? Abby said you wouldn't know. He said you wouldn't know mama. He said you know them pills you had for Alfred on the windowsill. I put them in yellow's dinner. I said Abby ain't you ashamed. Ain't you ashamed of yourself. I said she had them all day long in the house. That's a shame. Oh he was sick. He…

do. You know Freddie Williams? No. Detective in the Roosevelt Hotel? No. I don't know. What did he play? Trombone? He played trombone he was a kid too you know. But he was getting by the neck and shove him up against
